guidelines.title: static validation on submit default
guidelines.rule: Static validation on submit is the recommended default — errors appear together via ErrorSummary above the form; focus moves to the summary heading. Dual-cite NN/g prefer-inline and GCDS blur-validate; conflict flag, not a house winner. Unique claim: submit-time summary as the cognitive default.
pass_when: Submit-time ErrorSummary above the form with focus to the summary heading or (dual-cite) inline/blur school applied consistently — not mixed as one house winner.
fail_when: Schools mixed on one form (submit-summary and blur-inline claimed as one default) with no cited system.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house winner vs NN/g inline / GCDS blur; ErrorSummary link-text row as this timing row.

guidelines.title: errorsummary link text equals field error
guidelines.rule: ErrorSummary link text = the field’s error text — same wording in both places so either context still reads.
pass_when: Each ErrorSummary link uses the same wording as that field’s error text.
fail_when: Summary link wording differs from the field error (e.g. only the field label in the summary).
guidelines.do_not_claim: Submit-time default as this wording row; GOV.UK error summary as a merge that drops same-wording.

guidelines.title: default required optional in parentheses
guidelines.rule: Default: fields are required; optional is `(optionalText)` in parentheses on the label. Dual-cite NL `(niet verplicht)` / NN/g; this names the Finnish default-required + parenthetical optional. Locked dual-cite; no house marker.
pass_when: One named school applied consistently: default-required + optional in parentheses (Suomi.fi); or NL `(niet verplicht)` + above-form key; or mark-the-minority; or mark-both.
fail_when: Optional vs required unmarked; schools mixed on one form; a house marker invented.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house required marker; NL Dutch wording as this Finnish parenthetical row.

guidelines.title: toast 10s hover stick then float
guidelines.rule: Toast: 10 seconds or while hovered; slide out the top; stick then float top-right on scroll — success that needs no action. Dual-cite Spectrum ≥5s vs Ant Message 3s; no house seconds.
pass_when: Duration is one named school applied consistently (Suomi.fi 10s or while hovered; Spectrum ≥5s; Ant 3s). Suomi.fi geometry when that school is used: stick-top then float top-right after scroll; slide-out dismiss; success with no required response.
fail_when: A house seconds value not in {10s+hover, ≥5s, 3s}; or a success-toast that requires a response; or collapsing the three durations into one house timer.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house toast duration; Notification first-load split as this row.

guidelines.title: notification first load not post action
guidelines.rule: Notification is first-load page content, not a post-action pop-in — `role="region"`. Dynamic after interaction → InlineAlert. Dual-cite NSW in-page vs global alert.
pass_when: `Notification` is on the initial page load; post-action dynamic feedback uses InlineAlert.
fail_when: `Notification` is used as a post-interaction popup.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Toast row; NSW in-page vs global as a merge; ErrorSummary.

guidelines.title: hide breadcrumbs on mobile
guidelines.rule: Hide breadcrumbs on mobile — content starts higher; mobile breadcrumb is hard motorically. Dual-cite USWDS omit-on-home; this is viewport hide, not home omit. Don’t use breadcrumbs on 2–3 level sites.
pass_when: Breadcrumbs are hidden at mobile viewport; not used on 2–3 level sites.
fail_when: Mobile shows a breadcrumb trail; or breadcrumbs are used on a 2–3 level site.
guidelines.do_not_claim: USWDS omit-on-home as this viewport-hide row.

guidelines.title: button max three words mobile full width
guidelines.rule: Button label ≤3 words; verb; capital first letter; full-width on mobile, shrink-to-content on desktop. Inverted variant not on images unless contrast holds. Dual-cite Actions explicit verb; unique bits are the three-word cap and mobile full-width.
pass_when: Action labels ≤3 words, verb-first, capital first letter; small screens span the viewport; desktop width follows the label; inverted not on images unless contrast holds.
fail_when: Action label longer than three words; mobile button does not span the viewport; desktop is a fixed wide block; inverted on an image without contrast.
guidelines.do_not_claim: One primary per view; Actions explicit-verb without the three-word cap.

guidelines.title: time field 60px hint tmm always visible
guidelines.rule: Time field is fixed ~60px; hint `t.mm` always visible; component normalises to Finnish time — not placeholder-only format. Dual-cite USWDS time picker increments. Placeholder/label lock: format is not only in a placeholder.
pass_when: Time input is ~60px wide; `t.mm` hint is always visible; value is normalised to Finnish time.
fail_when: Time format lives only in a placeholder; field is far wider than the named ~60px with no always-visible hint.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Date `PP.KK.VVVV` hint as this time row; USWDS increments as a merge.

guidelines.title: date hint ppkkvvvv calendar optional focus trap
guidelines.rule: Date hint `PP.KK.VVVV` (or `p.k.vvvv`) always visible; calendar optional; focus is trapped while the calendar is open. Dual-cite USWDS typeable date / GOV.UK memorable date.
pass_when: Date format hint is always visible; the field is typeable; calendar (if present) is optional and traps focus while open.
fail_when: Date format is only in a placeholder; calendar is the only entry path; calendar open without focus trap.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Time `t.mm` row; USWDS typeable / GOV.UK memorable as a merge that drops the Finnish hint + trap.

guidelines.title: search hide label only if name states context
guidelines.rule: Search: visually hide the label only if the accessible name states the search context (“Hae sivustolta” / “Hae toimipisteitä”). Placeholder is visual extra. Clear control appears once there is a query. Skip search on tiny single-page tools. Placeholder/label lock: this is not a general placeholder-as-label pass.
pass_when: If the search label is visually hidden, the accessible name states context; placeholder is extra; clear appears once there is a query; tiny single-page tools may omit search.
fail_when: Visually hidden search label with a generic name that does not state context; or ordinary non-search fields hide the label citing this.
guidelines.do_not_claim: NL header-search placeholder exception as this context-name row; GOLD search placement.

guidelines.title: pagination skip link to listing
guidelines.rule: Pagination: skip-link (or in-page link) back to the listing; optional page-number field when there are many pages; SR copy without odd punctuation (“Sivu 1 kautta 20”). Dual-cite USWDS/NSW pagination.
pass_when: A skip/in-page link returns to the listing; many-page sets may include a page-number field; SR text avoids odd punctuation.
fail_when: Pagination has no way back to the listing start; SR copy uses odd punctuation instead of the named pattern.
guidelines.do_not_claim: USWDS/NSW pagination as a merge that drops skip-back-to-listing.

guidelines.title: toggle button immediate input submit
guidelines.rule: Toggle has two variants: `button` (immediate action) vs `input` (in a form) — always one default state; not a checkbox. Dual-cite Ant/Lightning immediate-toggle; Suomi names the form-input variant. Locked dual-cite by variant; no global winner.
pass_when: Button-toggle applies immediately with no extra confirm; input-toggle waits for submit — or Ant/Lightning always-immediate switch used as that school on that surface. Checkbox is not the state-change control. Always one default state.
fail_when: Button-toggle requires extra confirm; input-toggle applies immediately while treated as a submit-time form control; checkbox used for state change; a global “all switches immediate” house rule that erases the variant split.

guidelines.title: radio extras hidden then indented
guidelines.rule: Radio extras: additional fields stay hidden, then show indented under the selected radio — not a second “radios vs checkboxes” row.
pass_when: Extra fields for a radio are hidden until that radio is selected, then appear indented under it.
fail_when: Extra fields for unselected radios are visible; extras appear unindented / disconnected from the selected radio.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Radios vs checkboxes vs toggle (already filed).

guidelines.title: file hint and datetime fieldset
guidelines.rule: File: `hintText` states max size / types / count; `dragAreaText` names drag-and-drop; `addedFileAriaText` is read before the filename; `removeFileText` names remove. Dual-cite USWDS prefer-one-file. Datetime combo: wrap date+time in a fieldset with a legend; desktop uses external HintText/StatusText ids on `aria-describedby`; mobile uses built-in hint/status because fields stack.
pass_when: File hints name size/types/count; drag and remove strings are named; added-file SR text precedes the filename. Date+time share a fieldset/legend; desktop external hint/status ids; mobile built-in hint/status on stacked fields.
fail_when: File input has no size/types/count hint; date+time are unrelated fields with no shared legend; desktop omits external describedby ids while claiming this pattern.
guidelines.do_not_claim: USWDS prefer-one-file / file types+size as a merge that drops the named string props; date-hint `PP.KK.VVVV` as this fieldset row.
